description.value: Ruex Café & Bar is a brunch-focused restaurant in Surrey's Fraser Highway corridor, blending bold global flavours with modern takes on classics in a sit-down café-bar setting. The kitchen caters to a wide range of dietary needs with dedicated gluten-free, vegan, and dairy-free menus alongside the main menu. Beyond dining, the venue hosts community events such as a weekly run club and offers private event space and catering services.
